title: Neon Breakout
description: Smash glowing bricks, chase combos, and clear every level before your lives run out.

title: Neon Snake
description: Eat, grow and speed up. Grab the bonus stars before they fade, and don't bite your own tail.

title: Neon Stack
description: Rotate, slide and drop falling blocks to clear lines. Hold a piece for later and chain combos as the speed climbs.
controls: Arrows + X/Z / drag and tap / gamepad

title: Astro Blaster
description: Thrust, drift and blast through waves of splitting space rocks. Watch out for the saucer from wave 3.

title: Neon Runner
description: Sprint through a synthwave city. Jump, double jump and slide past barriers, drones and gaps as the pace keeps climbing.

title: Star Siege
description: Hold the line against marching alien waves. Duck behind shields, snipe the mothership, and team up with a friend in co-op.

title: Neon Hop
description: Hop across four lanes of traffic and a river of drifting logs and diving turtles to fill all five docks before the timer runs out.

title: Neon Pong
description: The original paddle duel with spin and speed-ups. Take on the CPU or a friend, first to 7.

title: Neon Maze
description: Clear the maze while four chasers with their own tactics close in. Grab a power cell and turn the hunt around.

title: Neon Pinball
description: A glowing table of bumpers, slingshots, drop targets and rollover lanes. Build the multiplier to x5 across three balls.

title: Neon Lander
description: Ease a thrusting lander down onto a glowing pad over rough alien terrain. Land slow and upright to score, then face stronger gravity, narrower pads and wind.

title: Neon Mines
description: Clear a glowing minefield using the number clues, flagging every mine you find. Pick easy, medium or hard, chase your best time, or take on the daily board everyone shares.
controls: Click + right-click / tap + hold / arrows + Space / gamepad

title: Neon Golf
description: Nine neon mini golf holes with sand traps, water, boost pads and sliding blockers. Drag back, let fly, and sink it in as few strokes as you can.

title: Neon Crates
description: Push glowing crates onto their targets across 15 hand-built warehouse puzzles. Push one at a time, never pull, and chase par on every level.

title: Neon Match
description: Swap glowing gems to line up three or more. Chain cascades, build line blasts and bombs, and race the clock or make every move count.
controls: Drag or tap / arrows + Space / gamepad

title: Neon Bubbles
description: Bank neon bubbles off the walls, pop groups of three and cut whole clusters loose for big bonuses before the ceiling creeps down.

title: Neon Tanks
description: Lob shells over glowing hills, carve craters and bury your rival before they bury you. Read the wind, then take on the CPU or a friend, best of 3.
